What is a CI Rotary Gear Pump?

A Cast Iron (CI) rotary gear pump is a type of positive displacement pump that uses the meshing of gears to transfer fluid from the inlet to the outlet. The gears trap fluid in the spaces between the teeth and move it smoothly through the system. The robust cast iron construction ensures high strength, long service life, and the ability to handle a wide variety of fluids, including high-viscosity materials. This makes CI rotary gear pumps suitable for demanding industrial environments, providing consistent and reliable performance.
